title: Quentin and the Harvest
author: Ivo Sandoval
blurb: Vesper Oyelaran, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
